title: When comparison hardens the eye
subtitle: A shorter sitting for envy to melt into praise
description: Let the image of metal merging with metal interrupt the separate self that keeps ranking, then return the eye to praise, true action, and homecoming.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Praise absorbs the self into the Praiseworthy Lord the way metal merges with metal and takes on one color.
heroSource.lifeApplication: When someone else’s life starts ranking yours, turn the gaze into praise before the self hardens around comparison.

evidence.coreClaim: This bundle treats comparison as a hardening of the separate self. The cited shabad answers with fusion, crimson truth, saintly company, and the inward door found through true action.
evidence.turn: From ranking the self against others into praise that softens separation.
evidence.practicalImplication: Move through the three steps when envy has taken the eye: praise until the self softens, practice the comparison turn, then let mind-conquest keep the gaze from returning to ranking.
